]+/);const bad=segs.some(seg=>{const t=seg.trim();if(!/^git(\s|$)/.test(t))return false;if(/^git\s+push(\s|$)/.test(t)&&/(\s(--force|-f|--force-with-lease|--mirror|--delete)(\s|$)|\s[+:][A-Za-z0-9_./-]+)/.test(t))return true;if(/^git\s+reset(\s|$)/.test(t)&&/\s--hard(\s|$)/.test(t))return true;if(/^git\s+clean(\s|$)/.test(t)&&/(\s-[a-zA-Z]*f[a-zA-Z]*|\s--force)(\s|$)/.test(t))return true;if(/^git\s+branch(\s|$)/.test(t)&&/\s-D(\s|$)/.test(t))return true;if(/^git\s+checkout(\s|$)/.test(t)&&/(\s--\s*\.|\s(-f|--force)(\s|$))/.test(t))return true;if(/^git\s+restore(\s|$)/.test(t)&&/\s\.(\s|$)/.test(t))return true;if(/^git\s+tag(\s|$)/.test(t)&&/\s(-d|--delete)(\s|$)/.test(t))return true;return false;});process.stdout.write(JSON.stringify(bad?{decision:'ask',reason:'Blocked by V6 git-destructive-guard: destructive git command requires explicit user confirmation.'}:{decision:'allow'})+'
');}catch{process.stdout.write(JSON.stringify({decision:'allow'})+'
');}});"
